Class GameSession

java.lang.Object
restserver.GameSession
public class GameSession extends Object
Holds all state for one active game between the AI opponent and a student player. One GameSession is created per registration (m0) and stored in the GameRegistry keyed by its gameId. It wraps the existing Game class without modifying it.
